label: failed-screenshot
notes: IMG_4278 — a real screenshot from the sudoku app the user actually plays; tesseract almost completely failed to fill the grid (a handful of cells, all wrong). Root-caused to tesseract's classifier genuinely misreading this app's thin, off-center '1' glyph as '4', consistent across PSM modes and upscaling — this is the failure that prompted the whole multi-font template-matching effort. Both '1' digits in this grid (r2c9, r5c1) are flagged as regressionCells; the harness reports them separately regardless of which one was in the original isolated-cell test.
